name: toggle-button-ios
description: A button that toggles between on and off, with a different appearance for each state (SPToggleButton). The label can be the same in both states, or differ (onText/offText, onIcon/offIcon).

anatomy.name: container
anatomy.description: Button background; its style changes between the off and on states.

anatomy.name: icon
anatomy.description: Optional leading icon; may differ between states.

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.description: Button text; may differ between states.
